As part of the fifth division of the work, the text applies the interrogative and dialectical method characteristic of the *Yamaka* to dhammas examined across the temporal dimensions of the present and the future [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. The closest textual correspondences occur with adjacent sections of the fifth chapter of the *Yamaka*, particularly the *Uppādavāra* (Ya 5.2.1; 48 matches), the *Uppādanirodhavāra* (Ya 5.2.3; 36 matches), the *Nirodhavāra* (Ya 5.2.2; 19 matches), the *Atītānāgatavāra* (Ya 5.3.6), and the *Paccuppannātītavāra* (Ya 5.3.4) [DharmaNexus].
